releases.body: Phantom Movies v1.5.4 improves the home toolbar layering, keeps Settings cleaner, moves the app version to the bottom of Settings, and embeds Continue Watching progress into the poster art.
Phantom Movies v1.5.3 makes update alerts GitHub release based, removes Firebase topic update delivery, and checks GitHub immediately when update alerts are enabled.
Phantom Movies v1.5.2 adds app version details in Settings, fixes Continue Watching artwork, and improves watch history resume polish.
Phantom Movies v1.5.1 adds redesigned Continue Watching cards with watch progress, improved resume controls, better watch history artwork, and extra Phantom Movies UI polish.

Phantom Movies v1.5.0 brings a complete UI overhaul with a fresh dark interface, redesigned home and detail screens, improved TV season and episode browsing, better foldable device layouts, local watch history, and a new Phantom Movies player experience.
